A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MuCo study and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A-G. Text comparison and visual inspection support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original MuCo experiments on MMEB and M-BEIR, computational-efficiency measurements and ablations, including supplementary results.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark evaluations, efficiency measurements and main-text and appendix ablations.

M1.justification: The multi-turn embedding procedure, contrastive objectives, logit masking and single-turn reconstruction adaptation are unchanged. Figure 2 illustrates compounded supervision already described and tested in v1.

E1.justification: Both versions use M3T, mmE5 and MegaPairs and evaluate the same MMEB and M-BEIR tasks, including global and local retrieval. Table A's added modality row completes the description of the existing mmE5 dataset; it does not establish expanded coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding main and appendix experiments, including MMEB Tables 1/J and M-BEIR Tables 2/H/I. Bibliographic updates do not introduce different evaluated methods.

E3.justification: Table A corrects reported training-data quantities: MegaPairs samples change from 26,236,105 to 26,235,105, and mmE5 classification/retrieval pairs from 139,000/281,000 to 140,000/280,000. These are limited reporting revisions; no changed sampling procedure or rerun is established. Other experimental settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The dataset, turn-count, supervision, masking and reconstruction ablations in Tables 3-8 and D-G retain their settings and findings. Correcting the Table 7 row reference does not change the analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seed-based variability, confidence intervals or significance tests. The point-estimate reporting practice is unchanged.

E6.justification: Table 2 corrects MuCo-7B S-to-S recall from 54.1 to 54.0, and Table J corrects its fine-tuned A-OKVQA score from 604 to 60.4. Section 5.2 replaces local-pool scores with the already-tabulated global results: overall 54.2/58.7 becomes 51.6/56.6, and M-to-M 68.7/74.3 becomes 64.8/70.4. These are reporting corrections, not demonstrated performance declines.

T1.justification: Rendered Equations (1)-(8) retain the same mathematical definitions, objectives and negative-set constructions. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or substantively revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about multi-turn learning, M3T, efficiency and benchmark leadership. Corrected results prose does not redefine these claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning contextual supervision, masking, data diversity and generalization are retained. Figure 2's new annotation restates an existing mechanism explanation; no substantive limitations or applicability qualifications are added.

D1.justification: Table A newly reports 14,081 mmE5 text-to-image-plus-text pairs, completing the modality counts to the already-stated 560,000 samples. Implementation settings, synthesis prompts and code/data access information remain unchanged; Appendix A's learning-rate clarification already appears in v1.

R1.justification: Both versions cite the same 70 works and retain the same research positioning. Several references receive publication-venue or author-metadata updates, without adding or removing research works.

P1.justification: Edits correct spelling, spacing and the Table 7 row reference, update bibliographic metadata, and replace several specific appendix pointers with generic supplementary-material references. The narrative and section structure remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 receives modest formatting adjustments; Figure 2 adds purple compounded-supervision arrows and an explanatory caption clause. Table A gains a modality row, and v2 adds page numbers with limited text reflow. The remaining displays are substantially retained.

improvement.justification: v2 improves reporting accuracy by aligning Section 5.2 with the global M-BEIR tables and correcting numerical errors in Tables 2 and J. The completed dataset breakdown and clearer Figure 2 also help readers. These limited gains outweigh the less precise appendix pointers, while the underlying method and experimental evidence remain essentially unchanged.
